description: Unable to find the requested paladin mercy.

deceived.name: Deceived
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Deceived" info="The target can immediately attempt a new saving throw to disbelieve any ongoing illusions that it failed to disbelieve within the last minute.&FN&"}

fatigued.name: Fatigued
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Fatigued" info="The target is no longer fatigued.&FN&"}

riled.name: Riled
description: :::block

::row{title="&L&Riled" info="The paladin's lay on hands also acts as ‹spell/calm emotions›, but only for the purpose of suppressing morale bonuses (such as from the ‹spell/rage› spell) and emotion effects that aren't fear effects. Use the paladin's level as the caster level.&FN&"}

shaken.name: Shaken
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Shaken" info="The target is no longer shaken.&FN&"}

sickened.name: Sickened
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Sickened" info="The target is no longer sickened.&FN&"}

dazed.name: Dazed
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Dazed" info="The target is no longer dazed.&FN&"}

diseased.name: Diseased
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Diseased" info="The paladin's lay on hands ability also acts as ‹spell/remove disease›, using the paladin's level as the caster level.&FN&"}

enfeebled.name: Enfeebled
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Enfeebled" info="The paladin ‹spell/dispel«s› any magical effects that are reducing one of the target's ability scores (paladin's choice).&FN&"}

haunted.name: Haunted
description: :::block

::row{title="&L&Haunted" info="The paladin's lay on hands also acts as ‹spell/protection from evil›, but only for the purpose of allowing a new saving throw against enchantment (charm) and enchantment (compulsion) effects, making the target immune to any attempts to possess or exercise mental control over the target, or preventing a life force from controlling the target (all as described in the second effect of protection from evil). Use the paladin's level as the caster level.&FN&"}

staggered.name: Staggered
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Staggered" info="The target is no longer staggered, unless the target is at exactly 0 hit points.&FN&"}

targeted.name: Targeted
description: :::block

::row{title="&L&Targeted" info="The paladin's lay on hands also acts as ‹spell/sanctuary›, using the paladin's level as the caster level. The saving throw DC to negate this effect is equal to 10 + 1/2 the paladin's level + the paladin's Charisma modifier.&FN&"}

confused.name: Confused
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Confused" info="The target is no longer confused.&FN&"}

cursed.name: Cursed
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Cursed" info="The paladin's lay on hands ability also acts as ‹spell/remove curse›, using the paladin's level as the caster level.&FN&"}

exhausted.name: Exhausted
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Exhausted" info="The target is no longer exhausted. The paladin must have the ‹mercy/fatigued› mercy before selecting this mercy.&FN&"}

frightened.name: Frightened
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Frightened" info="The target is no longer frightened. The paladin must have the ‹mercy/shaken› mercy before selecting this mercy.&FN&"}

injured.name: Injured
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Injured" info="The target gains ‹umr/fast healing› 3 for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the paladin's level.&FN&"}

nauseated.name: Nauseated
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Nauseated" info="The target is no longer nauseated. The paladin must have the ‹mercy/sickened› mercy before selecting this mercy.&FN&"}

poisoned.name: Poisoned
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Poisoned" info="The paladin's lay on hands ability also acts as ‹spell/neutralize poison›, using the paladin's level as the caster level.&FN&"}

amputated.name: Amputated
description: :::block

::row{title="&L&Amputated" info="The paladin's lay on hands also acts as ‹spell/regenerate›, but only for the purposes of regrowing severed body members, broken bones, and ruined organs. The paladin must have the ‹mercy/injured› mercy before she can select this mercy.&FN&"}

blinded.name: Blinded
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Blinded" info="The target is no longer blinded.&FN&"}

deafened.name: Deafened
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Deafened" info="The target is no longer deafened.&FN&"}

ensorcelled.name: Ensorcelled
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Ensorcelled" info="The paladin's lay on hands also acts as ‹spell/dispel magic›, using the paladin's level as her caster level (maximum 20).&FN&"}

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Paralyzed" info="The target is no longer paralyzed.&FN&"}

petrified.name: Petrified
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Petrified" info="The paladin's lay on hands ability also acts as ‹spell/stone to flesh›, but only for the purpose of removing the ‹rule/petrified› condition from a creature.&FN&"}

stunned.name: Stunned
description: :::block
::row{title="&L&Stunned" info="The target is no longer stunned.&FN&"}
